from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing ----------------
star_outer_radius = 40.0     # -> 80.0 point-to-point, 69.3 (2*34.6) across
star_inner_radius = 15.0     # notch radius (flat central disc)
star_points       = 6
start_angle       = 90.0     # a point straight up
plate_thickness   = 7.1
hole_diameter     = 22.3     # THRU

half_t = plate_thickness / 2.0

# cone that tapers the arms: full thickness inside r_in, sharp edge at R
slope     = half_t / (star_outer_radius - star_inner_radius)
apex_z    = half_t + slope * star_inner_radius          # 5.68
z_base    = -half_t
cone_h    = apex_z - z_base                             # 9.23
base_r    = star_outer_radius * cone_h / apex_z         # 65.0  (surface passes (40,0))

# ---------------- star profile ----------------
pts = []
for i in range(2 * star_points):
    ang = math.radians(start_angle + i * 180.0 / star_points)
    rad = star_outer_radius if i % 2 == 0 else star_inner_radius
    pts.append((rad * math.cos(ang), rad * math.sin(ang)))

star_face = Polygon(*pts, align=None)
plate = extrude(star_face, amount=half_t, both=True)

# ---------------- tented arms (lens side view, chevrons on top) ----------------
cone_up = Pos(0, 0, z_base) * Cone(base_r, 0.0, cone_h,
                                   align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
cone_dn = mirror(cone_up, Plane.XY)

part = plate & cone_up & cone_dn

# ---------------- central hole ----------------
part -= Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, plate_thickness * 3,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

part = part.clean()
part.name = "star_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.0                 # overall extrusion length
outer_size = 48.0             # square envelope (24 mm from centre to edge)
bar_width = 12.0              # width of each longitudinal bar
slot_width = 10.0             # width of each edge slot
slot_depth = 14.0             # how deep the slot reaches from the edge
slot_center = 16.0            # slot centre (edge at 24, slot ends at 12)
hole_diameter = 8.6           # central through bore
fillet_outer = 1.6            # R1.6 on the long outer corners
fillet_inner = 0.6            # R0.6 on the re-entrant (slot) corners

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- cross-section profile: square with 4 edge slots -------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as profile:
        Rectangle(outer_size, outer_size)

        # top / bottom slots
        with Locations((0, slot_center), (0, -slot_center)):
            Rectangle(slot_width, slot_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # left / right slots
        with Locations((slot_center, 0), (-slot_center, 0)):
            Rectangle(slot_depth, slot_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # central through bore
        Circle(hole_diameter / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- extrude along the length -----------------------------------
    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- fillet the long (axial) edges ------------------------------
    vertical_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

    # re-entrant edges = those lying on the slot mouths, i.e. inside the
    # outer envelope (the 12 corners of the four slots)
    inner_edges = [
        e for e in vertical_edges
        if abs(e.center().X) < outer_size / 2 - 1e-6
        and abs(e.center().Y) < outer_size / 2 - 1e-6
    ]
    outer_edges = [e for e in vertical_edges if e not in inner_edges]

    if inner_edges:
        fillet(inner_edges, radius=fillet_inner)
    if outer_edges:
        fillet(outer_edges, radius=fillet_outer)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - reverse engineered from the drawing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter      = 80.0     # Ø80 outer cylinder
inner_diameter      = 60.3     # Ø60.3 inner bore (through)
wall_thickness      = (outer_diameter - inner_diameter) / 2.0   # ~9.85
length              = 64.2     # overall axial length

bore_diameter       = 33.0     # Ø33 through bore (center)
groove_diameter     = 77.9     # Ø77.9 circumferential groove on outer face
groove_width        = 1.8      # axial width of the groove
groove_position     = 45.0     # groove center from the plain (bottom) end

spline_count        = 12       # internal splines
spline_depth        = 3.0      # radial depth of the spline teeth
spline_length       = 40.0     # axial extent of the splined region
spline_start        = 12.0     # splined region starts 12 mm from plain end

slot_width          = 2.5      # axial split slot width
slot_depth          = 6.0      # radial depth of the slot

chamfer_size        = 0.8      # chamfer on the top rim edges

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived radii
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_radius    = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius    = inner_diameter / 2.0
groove_radius   = groove_diameter / 2.0
bore_radius     = bore_diameter / 2.0
spline_root_r   = bore_radius
spline_tip_r    = bore_radius + spline_depth

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- main body: outer cylinder with Ø60.3 bore -------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ---- Ø77.9 circumferential groove on the outer surface ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(groove_position)) as sk_g:
        Circle(outer_radius)
        Circle(groove_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=groove_width / 2.0, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Ø33 through bore -------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk_b:
        Circle(bore_radius)
    extrude(amount=length, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- internal splines (12 teeth) ---------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(spline_start)) as sk_s:
        Circle(spline_root_r)
        with PolarLocations(spline_tip_r, spline_count):
            Rectangle(spline_depth, spline_depth, mode=Mode.ADD)
    extrude(amount=spline_length)

    # ---- axial split slot --------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, outer_radius - slot_depth / 2.0, 0)):
        Box(slot_width, slot_depth, length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chamfer the top rim edges
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
top_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
p.part = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = p.part

# ---------------- dimensions from drawing ----------------
tube_d      = 11.3          # vertical tube diameter
tube_r      = tube_d / 2
n_tubes     = 4
row_len     = 69.8          # overall length of tube row (Y)
overall_h   = 80.0          # overall height (Z)
bar_d       = 11.3          # manifold bar diameter
bar_r       = bar_d / 2
bar_z       = bar_r         # bar axis height (bottom of part at z = 0)
end_fillet  = 5.6           # 2x R5.6 on the two end bar bosses
pin_d       = 2.3           # 2x diameter 2.3 down pins
bead_d      = 13.6          # collar / bead ring diameter
bead_h      = 4.0
bead_z      = (76.0, 58.0)  # collar ring heights
pitch       = (row_len - tube_d) / (n_tubes - 1)   # 19.5

solids = []

# ---------------- vertical tubes + bead rings ----------------
for i in range(n_tubes):
    y = (i - (n_tubes - 1) / 2) * pitch
    solids.append(
        Pos(0, y, 0) * Cylinder(tube_r, overall_h,
                                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    )
    for z in bead_z:
        solids.append(Pos(0, y, z) * Cylinder(bead_d / 2, bead_h))

# ---------------- manifold bosses (axis along X) ----------------
for i in range(n_tubes):
    y = (i - (n_tubes - 1) / 2) * pitch
    boss = Pos(0, y, bar_z) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bar_r, tube_d)
    if i == 0 or i == n_tubes - 1:          # 2x R5.6 on the two end bosses
        boss = fillet(boss.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE), radius=end_fillet)
    solids.append(boss)

# ---------------- connecting web between bosses ----------------
solids.append(Pos(0, 0, bar_z) * Box(tube_d, row_len, bar_d * 0.5))

# ---------------- 2x Ø2.3 down pins ----------------
for y in (-pitch / 2, pitch / 2):
    solids.append(
        Pos(0, y, bar_z) * Cylinder(pin_d / 2, bar_z + 2.0,
                                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MAX))
    )

# ---------------- boolean -----------------
part = solids[0]
for s in solids[1:]:
    part = part + s

part.name = "manifold"
export_step(part, "output.step")

tip_hole_d   = 3.4
tip_boss_d   = 11.7          # tip bosses, R5.9 -> 96.5/2/sqrt2 + 5.9 = 40 -> 80 overall
arm_width    = 5.0           # 5 A/F
mid_bc       = 28.5          # 4x dia2.5 THRU on dia28.5 BC
inner_bc     = 23.7          # 4x dia2.5 THRU on dia23.7 BC
mid_hole_d   = 2.5

small_hole_d = 1.7

r_junction   = 4.2           # 8x R4.2  (arm / hub)
r_arm        = 0.8           # R0.8     (arm / tip boss)

tip_r   = tip_bc / 2.0       # 48.25
arm_ang = [45, 135, 225, 315]

# ---------------- flat profile ----------------
prof = Rectangle(hub_size, hub_size, rotation=45)
for a in arm_ang:
    prof += Rot(Z=a) * Rectangle(tip_r, arm_width, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER))
for a in arm_ang:
    prof += Rot(Z=a) * Pos(tip_r, 0) * Circle(tip_boss_d / 2)

# 8x R4.2 at the arm / hub junctions
junc = [v for v in prof.vertices() if 15 < v.center().length < 20]

# R0.8 at the arm / tip-boss junctions
junc2 = [v for v in prof.vertices() if 40 < v.center().length < 46]
prof = fillet(junc2, r_arm)

part = extrude(prof, amount=thickness)

# ---------------- holes ----------------
holes = []
for a in arm_ang:
    # 4x dia3.4 on dia96.5 BC  (arm tip)
    holes.append(Rot(Z=a) * Pos(tip_r, 0) * Cylinder(tip_hole_d / 2, thickness * 4))
    # 4x dia2.5 on dia28.5 BC  (on the arms)
    holes.append(Rot(Z=a) * Pos(mid_bc / 2, 0) * Cylinder(mid_hole_d / 2, thickness * 4))
for a in [0, 90, 180, 270]:

    holes.append(Rot(Z=a) * Pos(inner_bc / 2, 0) * Cylinder(mid_hole_d / 2, thickness * 4))

    holes.append(Rot(Z=a) * Pos(small_bc / 2, 0) * Cylinder(small_hole_d / 2, thickness * 4))

root_r        = 33.0

    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(root_r)

    # one pointed tooth: root -> tip -> root, then fillet the root edges
    p1 = (root_r * math.cos(-root_angle), root_r * math.sin(-root_angle))
    p2 = (tooth_tip_r, 0.0)
    p3 = (root_r * math.cos(root_angle),  root_r * math.sin(root_angle))
    with BuildSketch() as ts:
        with BuildLine() as tl:
            Polyline(p1, p2, p3, close=True)
        make_face()

fin_center_radius = (fin_inner_radius + fin_outer_radius) / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(disc_radius)
    extrude(amount=disc_thickness)

result = p.part

with BuildPart() as fins:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(fin_outer_radius)
        Circle(fin_inner_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=fin_height)

gap_length = fin_outer_radius * 2.0

from build123d import *
import math

# ----- dimensions from drawing -----
R_lobe       = 11.0          # R11.0 lobe outer radius
BC           = 66.9          # lobe bolt circle diameter
Rc           = BC / 2        # 33.45 lobe centre radius
lobe_hole_d  = 16.6          # 3x Ø16.6 THRU EQ SP ON BC
center_hole_d= 7.8           # Ø7.8 THRU
thickness    = 5.2           # plate thickness
cham         = 0.5           # small edge break

# concave waist arc (tangent to both neighbouring R11 lobes)
waist_rc       = 26.0
waist_center_r = 39.74       # |C - A| = waist_rc + R_lobe  -> smooth tangent

# lobe centres (top lobe up, two below)
lobe_angles  = [90 + 120 * i for i in range(3)]
lobe_centers = [(Rc * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
                 Rc * math.sin(math.radians(a))) for a in lobe_angles]

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        # convex hull of the three R11 lobes == offset of the centre triangle
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*lobe_centers, close=True)
        make_face()
        offset(amount=R_lobe, kind=Kind.ARC)

        # carve the three concave waists between lobes
        for i in range(3):
            a = math.radians(150 + 120 * i)
            with Locations((waist_center_r * math.cos(a),
                            waist_center_r * math.sin(a))):
                Circle(waist_rc, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # centre hole
        Circle(center_hole_d / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # three lobe holes
        for (cx, cy) in lobe_centers:
            with Locations((cx, cy)):
                Circle(lobe_hole_d / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=thickness)
    chamfer(p.part.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY), cham)

part = p.part
part.name = "trefoil_gasket"
export_step(part, "output.step")

width = 26.4                # ring width / axial thickness

boss_len = 20.7             # hub length

hole_dia = 23.3             # four large through holes
hole_pitch_radius = 22.0    # radial position of the four holes
groove_radius = 38.2        # shallow outer groove
groove_depth = 0.5
knurl_pitch = 5.0           # circumferential knurl pitch
knurl_depth = 1.0           # knurl groove depth
knurl_axial = 2.0           # knurl groove axial width

outer_radius = outer_dia / 2
inner_radius = inner_dia / 2
boss_radius = boss_dia / 2
hole_radius = hole_dia / 2
knurl_width = knurl_pitch * 0.7
knurl_count = int(math.floor(math.tau * outer_radius / knurl_pitch))
if knurl_count < 6:
    knurl_count = 6

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    # ring: revolve rectangular profile about the Y axis
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((inner_radius, -width / 2), (inner_radius, width / 2))
            Line((inner_radius, width / 2), (outer_radius, width / 2))
            Line((outer_radius, width / 2), (outer_radius, -width / 2))
            Line((outer_radius, -width / 2), (inner_radius, -width / 2))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # central hub boss
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_len, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.ADD)

    # central through bore
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(bore_radius, width + 2, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # four large through holes (0/90/180/270 deg)
    for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
        with Locations(Rot(0, ang, 0) * Pos(hole_pitch_radius, 0, 0)):
            Cylinder(hole_radius, width + 2, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # shallow outer groove (Ø76.4, 0.5 deep) on the +Y face
    with Locations((0, width / 2 - groove_depth / 2, 0)):
        Cylinder(groove_radius, groove_depth, rotation=(90, 0, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # knurled rim: many small shallow grooves around the +Y face
    for i in range(knurl_count):

    with BuildSketch():

from build123d import *

# ---------- Envelope ----------
plate_width     = 80.0
plate_height    = 58.0
plate_thickness = 4.9
corner_radius   = 2.9

# ---------- Hole / slot pitches ----------
pitch_xy    = 19.3
small_pitch = 20.0

# ---------- Base plate ----------
part = Box(plate_width, plate_thickness, plate_height)
part = fillet(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), corner_radius)

def through_hole(x, z, dia):
    return Pos(x, 0, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(dia / 2, plate_thickness + 10)

def through_slot(x, z, length, width):
    """Vertical slot (long axis along Z) cut through the plate."""
    sk = SlotOverall(length, width)
    cut = extrude(sk, plate_thickness + 10)
    # SlotOverall in XY plane: length along X. Rotate so length becomes vertical (Z),
    # then position, then translate to pass through the plate.
    return Pos(x, -(plate_thickness + 10) / 2, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * cut

# ---------- 12x D18.3 THRU  (4 cols x 3 rows) ----------
for i in range(4):
    for j in range(3):
        x = (i - 1.5) * pitch_xy
        z = (j - 1.0) * pitch_xy
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 18.3)

# ---------- 6x D5.8 THRU  (3 cols x 2 rows) ----------
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(2):
        x = (i - 1.0) * pitch_xy
        z = (j - 0.5) * pitch_xy
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 5.8)

# ---------- 6x D3.9 THRU  (2 cols x 3 rows) ----------
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(3):
        x = (i - 0.5) * (2 * pitch_xy)
        z = (j - 1.0) * small_pitch
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 3.9)

# ---------- 8x D2.9 THRU at lattice nodes ----------
for x in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, -0.5 * pitch_xy,
              0.5 * pitch_xy,  1.5 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_hole(x, z, 2.9)

# ---------- 4x SLOT 7.8 x 28.8 (vertical, long axis Z) ----------
for x in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.0 * pitch_xy, 1.0 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_slot(x, z, 28.8, 7.8)

# ---------- 6x SLOT 7.8 x 9.5 ----------
for x in (-2.5 * pitch_xy, 0.0, 2.5 * pitch_xy):
    for z in (-1.5 * pitch_xy, 1.5 * pitch_xy):
        part -= through_slot(x, z, 9.5, 7.8)

part.name = "perforated_plate"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
from math import radians, cos

# ---- Dimensions from the drawing (mm) ----
thickness      = 11.4     # plate thickness
flat_to_flat   = 79.8     # hexagon across flats
hex_radius     = flat_to_flat / (2 * cos(radians(30)))   # circumradius = 46.0
boss_radius    = 35.0 / 2 # central round boss
slot_leg_len   = 24.8     # length of each vertical leg
slot_leg_width = 8.2      # width of each vertical leg
slot_cross_len = 30.3     # length of connecting crossbar
slot_cross_wid = 8.2      # width of connecting crossbar
top_chamfer    = 2.3      # C2.3 on top perimeter edges
bot_fillet     = 1.1      # 2x R1.1 on bottom edges

with BuildPart() as p:
    # Hexagonal plate (flat top/bottom faces)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        RegularPolygon(hex_radius, 6, rotation=30)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # Central round boss
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(boss_radius)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # H-slot cut through the plate: two legs + connecting crossbar
    leg_x = slot_cross_len / 2 + slot_leg_width / 2
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(thickness)):
        with Locations((-leg_x, 0), (leg_x, 0)):
            Rectangle(slot_leg_width, slot_leg_len)
        Rectangle(slot_cross_len, slot_cross_wid)
    extrude(amount=-(thickness + 2), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Chamfer top perimeter edges (C2.3)
    top_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    p.part = chamfer(top_face.edges(), top_chamfer)

    # Round bottom perimeter edges (2x R1.1)
    bot_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    p.part = fillet(bot_face.edges(), bot_fillet)

part = p.part
part.name = "hex_plate_with_h_slot"
export_step(part, "output.step")

                (x_bot + front_width, y_bot),
                (x_top + front_width, y_top),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    # extrude along Z to the printed height

from build123d import *
import math

# --- Target dimensions (from drawing) ---
length    = 80.0     # X extent
height    = 60.4     # Z extent
width_top = 61.7     # Y width of top face
width_bot = 39.3     # Y width of bottom face
angle_bot = 88.9     # deg between bottom edge and side edge
angle_top = 87.7     # deg between top edge and side edge

# --- Derive the side-edge tilt so both angles are satisfied ---
# Bottom edge direction: (0, 1, 0)
# Side edge direction:   (0, dy, dz)
# angle_bot = 180 - atan2(dz, dy)  ->  dy/dz = tan(angle_bot)
# angle_top = atan2(dz, dy)        ->  dy/dz = tan(angle_top)
# They differ by 1.2 deg, so use the mean (within print tolerance).
mean_angle = (angle_bot + angle_top) / 2.0
slope = math.tan(math.radians(mean_angle))   # dy / dz
dz = height / math.sqrt(1.0 + slope * slope)
dy = dz * slope                               # ~ 60.4 (matches width_top)

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        # Rectangle in YZ plane, rotated about the X axis by mean_angle,
        # so its top and bottom edges are horizontal (parallel to Y)
        # and its side edges carry the 88.9 / 87.7 deg angles.
        Rectangle(width_bot, height, rotation=mean_angle)
    extrude(amount=length)

part = p.part
part.name = "extruded_profile"
export_step(part, "output.step")

        make_face()

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - per drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gear_thickness    = 8.5      # plate thickness
lobe_count        = 12       # number of outer lobes
tip_radius        = 40.0     # lobe tip radius (from centre)
root_radius       = 31.0     # valley / root radius (from centre)
central_bore_dia  = 18.5     # central through bore

# two rings of three clearance holes
ring_hole_dia     = 11.4
ring1_radius      = 17.05    # inner ring  (3x)
ring2_radius      = 22.75    # outer ring  (3x)
ring_hole_count   = 3
ring1_angle       = 90.0     # both rings aligned (holes on same rays)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smooth lobe (wave) profile: radius = root + amp * (1 + sin(n*theta))/2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lobe_amplitude    = tip_radius - root_radius

def lobe_radius(theta: float) -> float:
    wave = 0.5 * (1.0 + math.sin(lobe_count * theta))
    return root_radius + lobe_amplitude * wave

def lobe_profile_points(n_pts: int = 300):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n_pts):
        t = 2.0 * math.pi * i / n_pts
        r = lobe_radius(t)
        pts.append((r * math.cos(t), r * math.sin(t)))
    return pts

profile_pts = lobe_profile_points()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the gear body (loft between two identical wave profiles)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as gear:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY)                          as s1:
        Polygon(*profile_pts, align=None)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(gear_thickness))   as s2:
        Polygon(*profile_pts, align=None)
    loft()

solid_body = gear.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central through bore
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_bore_dia / 2, gear_thickness * 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two rings of three clearance holes (aligned on the same rays)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for ring_radius in (ring1_radius, ring2_radius):
    for i in range(ring_hole_count):
        ang = math.radians(ring1_angle + i * 360.0 / ring_hole_count)
        px = ring_radius * math.cos(ang)
        py = ring_radius * math.sin(ang)
        solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, py, 0) * Cylinder(
            ring_hole_dia / 2, gear_thickness * 2
        )

part = solid_body
part.name = "wave_gear"
export_step(part, "output.step")

disc_diameter = 80.0      # outer diameter of the base disc
disc_thickness = 4.0      # base disc thickness
tooth_count = 12          # number of gear teeth
tooth_root_radius = 34.0  # radius at the tooth roots
tooth_tip_radius = 40.0   # radius at the tooth tips (outer)
tooth_height = 11.0       # overall tooth height above the disc bottom
tooth_thickness = 2.5     # radial thickness of the tooth walls
tooth_tilt_deg = 30.0     # tangential tilt of the tooth walls
set_screw_diameter = 3.4  # central set-screw hole diameter

# ---- Base disc -------------------------------------------------------
base_disc = Pos(0, 0, disc_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(disc_diameter / 2, disc_thickness)

# ---- Single tilted tooth ---------------------------------------------
# Build a straight radial tooth from root to tip, then tilt it about the
# vertical axis through the part centre to give a twisted, tilted profile.
tooth = (
    Pos(tooth_root_radius + (tooth_tip_radius - tooth_root_radius) / 2, 0, tooth_height / 2)
    * Box(tooth_tip_radius - tooth_root_radius, tooth_thickness, tooth_height)
)
tooth = Rot(0, 0, tooth_tilt_deg) * tooth

# ---- Array teeth around the disc -------------------------------------
teeth = tooth
for i in range(1, tooth_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / tooth_count
    teeth = teeth + Rot(0, 0, angle) * tooth

# ---- Combine and cut the central set-screw hole ----------------------
result = base_disc + teeth
result = result - Cylinder(set_screw_diameter / 2, 50)

part = result
part.name = "gear_disc"

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- Dimensions from drawing ----
length        = 80.0     # extrusion length
size          = 26.7     # overall square envelope
half          = size / 2
r_corner      = 1.1      # 8x R1.1 outer corner fillets
r_slot        = 2.0      # 4x R2 inner slot fillets
c_lip         = 4.2      # 8x C4.2 chamfers on slot lips
hole_d        = 5.6      # central through hole

# T-slot geometry (typical for a 26.7 mm extrusion)
slot_open     = 6.2      # slot opening width
slot_inner    = 12.0     # interior channel width
slot_depth    = 9.0      # total slot depth from outer face

# ---- T-slot cross-section polygon (+X side) ----
def tslot_pts():
    return [
        ( half,               slot_open / 2 + c_lip),   # outer, wider (chamfered lip)
        ( half - c_lip,       slot_open / 2),           # after chamfer
        ( half - c_lip,       slot_inner / 2),          # channel shoulder
        ( half - slot_depth,  slot_inner / 2),          # deep inner corner (top)
        ( half - slot_depth, -slot_inner / 2),          # deep inner corner (bottom)
        ( half - c_lip,      -slot_inner / 2),          # channel shoulder
        ( half - c_lip,      -slot_open / 2),           # after chamfer
        ( half,              -(slot_open / 2 + c_lip)), # outer, wider
    ]

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- Profile: rounded square minus 4 T-slots ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        RectangleRounded(size, size, r_corner)
        for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
            a = math.radians(ang)
            ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
            pts = [(x * ca - y * sa, x * sa + y * ca) for x, y in tslot_pts()]
            with BuildLine():
                Polyline(*pts, close=True)
            make_face(mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- Central through hole ----
    Cylinder(hole_d / 2, length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part

# ---- Fillet the deep inner corners of each T-slot channel (R2) ----
deep_edges = []
for ang in (0, 90, 180, 270):
    a = math.radians(ang)
    ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    for y in (slot_inner / 2, -slot_inner / 2):
        xr = (half - slot_depth) * ca - y * sa
        yr = (half - slot_depth) * sa + y * ca
        for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z):
            c = e.center()
            if abs(c.X - xr) < 0.3 and abs(c.Y - yr) < 0.3:
                deep_edges.append(e)

if deep_edges:
    part = fillet(deep_edges, r_slot)

part.name = "tslot_rail"
export_step(part, "output.step")

R_bc     = hole_bc / 2.0
R_groove = groove_dia / 2.0
r_hole   = hole_dia / 2.0

mid = total_length / 2.0

# revolved half-profile (x = radius, y = axial)
profile = [
    (R_cbore, 0.0),
    (R_body,  0.0),
    (R_body,  end_len),
    (R_knurl, end_len),
    (R_knurl, end_len + knurl_width),
    (R_body,  end_len + knurl_width),
    (R_body,  total_length),
    (R_cbore, total_length),
    (R_cbore, total_length - cbore_depth),
    (R_bore,  total_length - cbore_depth),
    (R_bore,  mid + groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_groove, mid + groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_groove, mid - groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_bore,  mid - groove_width / 2.0),
    (R_bore,  cbore_depth),
    (R_cbore, cbore_depth),
    (R_cbore, 0.0),
]

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*profile, close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

# ---- straight knurl band (Ø80 x 6.2, middle) ----
knurl_count = int(round(math.pi * knurl_dia / knurl_pitch))
tooth_width = knurl_pitch * 0.5

           Cylinder(r_hole, total_length + 2.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
base = Box(block_length, block_width, block_height)

plate_thickness = 7.4          # uniform plate thickness

# lobed (scalloped) outer profile, 5 lobes
outer_radius = 38.0            # lobe tip radius
root_radius = 22.5             # radius at the lobe roots (scallops)
lobe_count = 5

# central through hole
center_hole_radius = 11.7      # Ø23.4

# hexagonal through cutouts, one per lobe
hex_diameter = 14.0            # across-flats hexagon
hex_radius = hex_diameter / (2 * math.cos(math.radians(30)))
hex_center_radius = 26.0       # radial position of each hex cutout

# lobe tips at 0, 72, 144, 216, 288 deg
tip_angles = [i * 360.0 / lobe_count for i in range(lobe_count)]
root_angles = [a + 360.0 / (2 * lobe_count) for a in tip_angles]

# smooth closed outline: tip points -> root points -> cubic Béziers between them
points = []
for a in tip_angles + root_angles:
    r = outer_radius if a in tip_angles else root_radius
    rad = math.radians(a)
    points.append((r * math.cos(rad), r * math.sin(rad)))

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # scalloped lobed outline
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        with BuildLine():
            Spline(*points, periodic=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # central through hole
    with BuildSketch() as s2:
        Circle(center_hole_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # hexagonal through cutouts, one centered in each lobe
    with BuildSketch() as s3:
        with PolarLocations(hex_center_radius, lobe_count, start_angle=0):
            RegularPolygon(hex_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Y-junction pipe fitting (3 equal tapered stepped arms @ 120 deg)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
arm_length = 80.0                      # overall arm length (Z)
root_width = 34.0                      # root square side
tip_width = 8.0                        # tip square side
steps = 10                             # number of square sections
step_h = arm_length / steps            # axial pitch
taper = (tip_width / root_width) ** (1.0 / steps)   # geometric taper

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet parameters (small blend radii on the stepped edges)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fillet_root = 0.4                      # radius on root (step 0) edges
fillet_mid = 0.3                       # radius on middle steps (1..steps-1) edges
fillet_tip = 0.2                       # radius on tip (step == steps) edges

# Y / X arms share the same stepped-square profile, rotated about Z
y_arm_angle = 90.0
x_arm_angle = -90.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build one tapered stepped-square arm (along +Z, base at z = 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
def stepped_square_arm() -> "Part":
    with BuildPart() as bp:
        for k in range(steps + 1):
            w = root_width * taper ** k
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(k * step_h)):
                Rectangle(w, w)
        loft()

    part = bp.part

    # group edges by their section index (z / step_h) and fillet each group
    groups: dict[int, list] = {}
    for e in part.edges():
        idx = int(round(e.center().Z / step_h))
        groups.setdefault(idx, []).append(e)

    for idx, edges in groups.items():
        r = (fillet_root if idx == 0
             else fillet_tip if idx == steps
             else fillet_mid)
        try:
            part = fillet(edges, r)
        except Exception:
            pass  # skip fillet if it fails on a degenerate edge set

    return part


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble the three-arm Y fitting
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
z_arm = stepped_square_arm()
y_arm = Rot(0, 0, y_arm_angle) * z_arm
x_arm = Rot(0, 0, x_arm_angle) * z_arm

part = z_arm + y_arm + x_arm
part.name = "stepped_square_y_fitting"

export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
bore_diameter = 29.6          # central bore
root_radius   = 22.0          # hub / root radius
tip_radius    = 40.0          # tooth tip radius
tooth_count   = 8             # number of teeth
tooth_angle   = 30.0          # tooth angular width
root_angle    = 360.0 / tooth_count - tooth_angle   # valley angular width
body_width    = 29.6          # gear axial width
tip_chamfer   = 2.5           # chamfer on the tooth-tip edges

# ---------------- polar profile ----------------
def arc_pts(r0, r1, a0, a1, n):
    """Points along a straight radial segment (in polar coords)."""
    pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = i / n
        r = r0 + (r1 - r0) * t
        a = a0 + (a1 - a0) * t
        pts.append((r * math.cos(math.radians(a)), r * math.sin(math.radians(a))))
    return pts

seg_tooth = 6
seg_root  = 4

profile_pts = []
for k in range(tooth_count):
    base = k * 360.0 / tooth_count
    profile_pts += arc_pts(root_radius, tip_radius, base, base + tooth_angle / 2, seg_tooth)
    profile_pts += arc_pts(tip_radius, root_radius, base + tooth_angle / 2, base + tooth_angle, seg_tooth)
    profile_pts += arc_pts(root_radius, root_radius, base + tooth_angle,
                           base + tooth_angle + root_angle, seg_root)

# ---------------- build the solid ----------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        Polygon(*profile_pts, align=None)
    extrude(amount=body_width / 2, both=True)

solid_body = p.part

# ---------------- central bore ----------------
solid_body -= Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, body_width * 2)

# ---------------- chamfer the tooth-tip edges ----------------
tip_edges = [e for e in solid_body.edges()
             if math.hypot(e.center().X, e.center().Z) > tip_radius - 0.5]
solid_body = chamfer(tip_edges, tip_chamfer)

part = solid_body
part.name = "gear"
export_step(part, "output.step")

bore_dia = 12.0               # central through bore
pocket_size = 20.0            # square side pockets (X / Z)
pocket_depth = 18.0           # pocket depth along the section axis
pocket_offset = 24.0          # pocket centre distance from the bore axis
chamfer_dist = 0.8            # small edge chamfers

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        # square outer profile
        Rectangle(outer_size, outer_size)

        # central through bore
        Circle(bore_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # four square side pockets (left, right, top, bottom)
        for sx, sz in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
            with Locations((sx * pocket_offset, sz * pocket_offset)):
                Rectangle(pocket_size, pocket_size, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=length / 2, both=True)

part = p.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chamfer the long (lengthwise) edges of the outer profile and the
# side pockets, but leave the bore and pocket mouths sharp.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
long_edges = part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)

bore_r = bore_dia / 2
pocket_half = pocket_size / 2

def keep(edge):
    c = edge.center()
    x, z = abs(c.X), abs(c.Z)
    # ignore edges on the bore
    if (x ** 2 + z ** 2) ** 0.5 < bore_r + 1.0:
        return False
    # outer profile edges: |x| or |z| near outer_size / 2
    if abs(x - outer_size / 2) < 1.0 or abs(z - outer_size / 2) < 1.0:
        return True
    # pocket edges: |x| or |z| near pocket_offset + pocket_half
    if abs(x - (pocket_offset + pocket_half)) < 1.0 or abs(
        z - (pocket_offset + pocket_half)
    ) < 1.0:
        return True
    return False

chamfer_edges = [e for e in long_edges if keep(e)]
if chamfer_edges:
    part = chamfer(chamfer_edges, chamfer_dist)

part.name = "square_tube_with_side_pockets"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

from build123d import *
from math import radians, cos, sin

# ---------------- dimensions taken from the target drawing ----------------
plate_t   = 5.7                          # web / plate land thickness
overall_t = 8.0                          # overall thickness
boss_t    = overall_t - plate_t          # 2.3 raised boss

hub_d     = 40.0                         # central hub diameter  (Ø40)
lobe_d    = 28.6                         # lobe outer diameter  (Ø28.6)
hub_r     = hub_d / 2.0
lobe_r    = lobe_d / 2.0

edge_dim  = 44.0                         # hub centre -> lobe outer extreme
lobe_off  = edge_dim - lobe_r            # 29.7  lobe centre distance

ctl_hole_r = 25.6 / 2.0                  # Ø25.6 THRU
hex_r      = 9.5                         # hexagonal through-hole circumradius
fillet_r   = 1.1                         # R1.1 blends

angles  = (60.0, 180.0, 300.0)
centres = [(lobe_off * cos(radians(a)), lobe_off * sin(radians(a))) for a in angles]

# ---------------- base web (5.7 thick): hub + three lobes ----------------
part = Cylinder(hub_r, plate_t, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
for x, y in centres:
    part += Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(lobe_r, plate_t,
                                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- raised bosses (up to 8.0 overall) ----------------
part += Pos(0, 0, plate_t) * Cylinder(hub_r, boss_t,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
for x, y in centres:
    part += Pos(x, y, plate_t) * Cylinder(lobe_r, boss_t,
                                          align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- central through hole (Ø25.6) ----------------
part -= Cylinder(ctl_hole_r, overall_t + 2.0,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

# ---------------- straight hexagonal through holes with R1.1 corners ----------------
for x, y in centres:
    hex_hole = RegularPolygon(hex_r, 6)
    try:
        hex_hole = fillet(hex_hole.vertices(), radius=fillet_r)   # R1.1 corners
    except Exception:
        pass
    part -= Pos(x, y, -1.0) * extrude(hex_hole, overall_t + 2.0)

# ---------------- R1.1 blends on all remaining edges ----------------
part = part.clean()
try:
    part = fillet(part.edges(), radius=fillet_r)
except Exception:
    try:
        part = fillet(part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE), radius=fillet_r)
    except Exception:
        pass

part = part.clean()
part.name = "3_lobe_hub"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

knob_radius = 30.25
knob_thickness = 5.9
shaft_radius = 4.6
shaft_length = 80.0
front_offset = 30.2          # shaft length before knob front face
offset_hole_d = 9.2          # offset hole diameter
center_hole_d = 6.0          # center hole diameter
offset_hole_r = 10.0         # radial distance of offset hole (per drawing)

# Shaft along Y, centered at origin (-40 .. +40)
shaft = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(shaft_radius, shaft_length)

# Knob positioned so its -Y face is 30.2 in from the shaft's -Y end
knob_center_y = -shaft_length / 2 + front_offset + knob_thickness / 2
knob = Pos(0, knob_center_y, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(knob_radius, knob_thickness)

part = knob + shaft

# Ø9.2 offset hole through the knob (upper-left in drawing)
hx = offset_hole_r * math.cos(math.radians(135))
hz = offset_hole_r * math.sin(math.radians(135))
offset_hole = Pos(hx, knob_center_y, hz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(offset_hole_d / 2, knob_thickness * 3)
part -= offset_hole

# Ø6.0 center hole through shaft + knob
center_hole = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(center_hole_d / 2, shaft_length * 2)
part -= center_hole
